items.title: Show HN: Spltty – a Markdown-based personal finance CLI built with Claude
items.why_it_matters: An indie developer built and shipped a personal finance CLI tool entirely managed by Claude, showing how to transition a project from a loose folder of AI files into a structured CLI. This is a direct blueprint for your vibe-coding workflow. This week, you can read their short write-up to see how they structured their Claude prompts to handle codebase expansion, and apply that exact prompting style to build the next feature of AI-ingest.

items.title: Show HN: Vocab Top – AI-powered vocabulary builder that helps you retain words
items.why_it_matters: An indie developer shipped Vocab Top, a clean, focused AI vocabulary builder. It is a great example of a simple, single-purpose AI utility that actually got put into the world instead of languishing in development. This week, you can analyze their landing page and user onboarding flow to copy their minimalist design patterns for your AI-ingest project.

items.title: Show HN: CostClaw, a local CLI that finds your Claude Code spend leaks
items.why_it_matters: Claude Code is incredibly powerful but can quickly burn through your API budget if you aren't careful. CostClaw is a new local CLI tool that audits your directory to find where your Claude Code spend leaks are happening. This week, run `npx costclaw audit` in your AI-ingest repository to see exactly how much your development sessions are costing you and where you can optimize.

items.title: Show HN: HUD, an open-source minimal terminal UI for ClaudeCode, Codex, OpenCode
items.why_it_matters: HUD is a new open-source, minimal terminal UI designed specifically to make reading and managing outputs from Claude Code and Codex much cleaner. Since you use Claude Code daily, this helps you track what the AI is writing without getting lost in terminal scrollback. This week, clone the repo and run it alongside your next Claude Code session to see if it speeds up your verification workflow.

items.title: WaitPerk: sponsors in your Claude Code status line, you get paid
items.why_it_matters: WaitPerk is a unique new tool that injects non-intrusive sponsor lines into your Claude Code status bar, paying you while you build. It is a direct way to start making micro-revenue from the hours you spend vibe coding. This week, install the CLI extension to start earning passive cents while you write the code for AI-ingest.

items.title: Show HN: Mirafold – Generative UI for Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI
items.why_it_matters: Mirafold brings generative UI capabilities directly to Claude Code and other CLIs, allowing you to visualize frontend components as you generate them. This bridges the gap between terminal coding and Next.js visual output. This week, run their CLI tool to preview a new UI component for AI-ingest directly from your terminal instead of constantly switching to your browser.
